records.isnad_en: Ismāʿīl b. ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us; he said: ʿAṭāʾ said to me concerning tayammum:
records.matn_en: [p. 141] “When he has wiped his hands with the dust, let him wipe his hands and his face once.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الْأَسْلَمِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ إِذَا تَيَمَّمَ يَمْسَحُ وَجْهَهُ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ»
records.isnad_en: ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿĀmir al-Aslamī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar,
records.matn_en: that when he performed tayammum he “would wipe his face once and his hands to the elbows.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، (. . .)
records.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَغَسَلُوهُ، فَمَاتَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قَتَلُوهُ قَتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ، أَوْ ضَيَّعُوهُ ضَيَّعَهُمُ اللَّهُ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Layth, (. . .)
records.matn_en: a man, in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and they washed him, and he died; and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “They killed him—may God kill them—or they ruined him—may God ruin them.”
translator_notes: The source has an ellipsis after the chain and the beginning of the report is missing.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «رُخِّصَ لِلْمَرِيضِ التَّيَمُّمُ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ مَجْدُورًا كَأَنَّهُ صَمْغَةٌ، كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Qatāda, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
records.matn_en: “Tayammum was made permissible for the sick person. Do you not see: if he had smallpox (majdūr), as though he were [covered in] gum, what would he do?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فِي الْمَجْدُورِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ، قَالَ:
records.isnad_en: Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, concerning the person with smallpox who is afflicted with janāba; he said:
records.matn_en: “He performs tayammum.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Performed Tayammum and Then Found Water
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ تَيَمَّمَ ثُمَّ وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فِي رَجُلٍ تَيَمَّمَ ثُمَّ وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ فِي وَقْتٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يُعِيدُ» يَعْنِي إِذَا صَلَّى
records.isnad_en: al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ibrāhīm, concerning a man who performed tayammum and then found water while there was still time; he said:
records.matn_en: “He does not repeat”—meaning, if he has prayed.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يُعِيدُ»
records.isnad_en: Ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jubayr b. Shayba, who said: I asked Abū Salama b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, and he said:
records.matn_en: “He does not repeat.”

narrators.en: ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jubayr b. Shayba

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ:
records.isnad_en: al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Layth, from Ṭāwūs, who said:
records.matn_en: “He does not repeat.”

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: يُعِيدُ
records.isnad_en: [p. 145] al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: He repeats.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

groups.title_en: Chapter on Eating Without Ablution

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ الْغَائِطَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَأُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَلَا تَوَضَّأُ؟ فَقَالَ: «أَأُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ؟»
records.isnad_en: Ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿAmr b. Dīnār, from Saʿīd b. al-Ḥuwayrith, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Prophet ﷺ, and he entered the privy, then came back, and food was brought to him. It was said to him: Will you not perform ablution? He said: “Am I about to pray, that I should perform ablution?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ، فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ، فَقِيلَ: أَلَا نَأْتِيكَ بِطَهُورٍ؟ فَقَالَ: أَخِّرْ عَنِّي طَهُورَكَ، فَإِنَّمَا قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ - أَظُنُّهُ - قَالَ: «أَسْتَطِيبُ بِشِمَالِي وَآكُلُ بِيَمِينِي»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān b. Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām b. ʿUrwa, from ʿUrwa, who said:
records.matn_en: ʿUmar (r) came out of the privy and food was brought near to him. It was said: Shall we not bring you water for purification? He said: “Put your purification behind me; for Abū Bakr said—I think—he said: ‘I cleanse myself with my left [hand] and eat with my right.’”
translator_notes: ‘I think’ is the narrator’s doubt about whether the saying was Abū Bakr’s.

groups.title_en: Chapter on Recitation Without Ablution

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَحْجُبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقُرْآنِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا الْجَنَابَةَ»
records.isnad_en: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAmr b. Murra, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Salama, from ʿAlī (r), who said:
records.matn_en: “Nothing used to keep the Prophet ﷺ from the Qurʾān except janāba.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " رَأَيْتُ غُلَامًا يُمْسِكُ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه الْمُصْحَفَ، فَيَقْرَأُ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ يَتَبَرَّزُ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ، فَيَقْرَأُ وَمَا مَسَّ مَاءً
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: “I saw a boy holding the muṣḥaf for ʿAlī (r) while he recited; then he stood up to relieve himself, then came back and recited, without having touched water.”
translator_notes: The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقْرَآنِ وَهُمَا عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ»
records.isnad_en: Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Salama b. Kuhayl, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, who said:
records.matn_en: “Ibn ʿUmar and Ibn ʿAbbās used to recite while not in a state of ablution.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَنْ، سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 148⦘ عَنْهُ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «اقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ جُنُبًا»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from one who heard ʿAlī (r) [p. 148] say:
records.matn_en: “Recite the Qurʾān as long as you are not in janāba.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ تُمَسَّ الدَّرَاهِمُ، الَّتِي فِيهَا السُّورَةُ الْمَكْتُوبَةُ وَهُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ»
records.isnad_en: Mindal b. ʿAlī narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from ʿAṭāʾ,
records.matn_en: that he “disliked that dirhams on which a sūra is written be touched while one is not in a state of ablution.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Prays While Holding Back the Two Foul Things (al-akhbathayn): Excrement and Urine
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ صَلَّى وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ: الْغَائِطَ وَالْبَوْلَ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " لَا تُدَافِعِ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ: الْغَائِطَ وَالْبَوْلَ "
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujāhid, from ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: “Do not hold back the two foul things: excrement and urine.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مَا أُبَالِي صَلَّيْتُ وَأَنَا أُدَافِعُ الْأَذَى، أَوْ كَانَ فِي ثَوْبِي»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from al-Ḥasan, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
records.matn_en: “I would not mind praying while holding back the filth (adhā), or if it were on my garment.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - فِي الْبَوْلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: مَا لَمْ يُعْجِلْكَ.
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan b. ʿUbayd Allāh, from Ibrāhīm—concerning [needing to] urinate during the prayer—; he said:
records.matn_en: As long as it does not make you hasten.

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَصُرُّهُ صَرًّا ⦗ص: 150⦘
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm b. Maysara, from Ṭāwūs, who said:
records.matn_en: We would tie it up tightly.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَضْغَطُهُ ضَغْطًا
records.isnad_en: [p. 150] Muḥammad b. Muslim narrated to us; he said: Ibrāhīm b. Maysara informed us, from Ṭāwūs, who said:
records.matn_en: We would press it hard.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from Muḥammad b. ʿAlī, who said:
records.matn_en: There is no harm in it.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا كَانَ لَا يُعْجِلُكَ فَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ
records.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: If it does not make you hasten, there is no harm in your praying.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: There is no harm in it.

records.matn_ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَنَصُرُّهُ صَرًّا
records.isnad_en: And ʿAbd al-Salām narrated to us, from Layth, from Ṭāwūs, who said:
records.matn_en: We would tie it up tightly.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

groups.title_en: Chapter on the Beginning of the Adhān

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: هَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْأَذَانِ حَتَّى نَقَسَ أَوْ كَادَ أَنْ يَنْقُسَ، قَالَ: «لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رِجَالًا فَيَقُومُونَ عَلَى آطَامِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَيُؤَذِّنُونَ النَّاسَ» فَجَاءَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رُؤْيَا، لَا إِنَّهَا عَنْ نَفْسِي، أُرِيتُ - إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ نَائِمًا - رَجُلًا عَلَيْهِ بُرْدَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ قَائِمٌ عَلَى حَائِطِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَذَّنَ، قَالَ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ مَكَثَ - أَوْ جَلَسَ قَلِيلًا - ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَقَالَ: «عَلِّمْهُنَّ بِلَالًا» قَالَ: فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، فَجَاءَ النَّاسُ سِرَاعًا، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ: رَأَيْتُ الَّذِيَ طَافَ بِهِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ سَبَقَنِي إِلَيْهِ
records.isnad_en: Qays b. al-Rabīʿ narrated to us, from ʿAmr b. Murra, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was anxious about the call to prayer (adhān) until he sighed—or was about to sigh—and said: “I have been minded to order men to stand on the roofs of Medina and call the people.” Then ʿAbd Allāh b. Zayd came and said: I saw a vision—it is not from myself; I was shown—for I was not asleep—a man wearing two green cloaks standing on the wall of the mosque, and he gave the adhān. He said: God is greatest, God is greatest; I testify that there is no god but God, I testify that there is no god but God; I testify that Muḥammad is the Messenger of God—twice; come to prayer, come to prayer; come to success, come to success; God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God. Then he waited—or sat for a little—then stood and said the like of what he had said, then said: The prayer has been established (qad qāmat al-ṣalāh). He (the Prophet ﷺ) said: “Teach them to Bilāl.” He said: So Bilāl gave the adhān, and the people came hurrying. He said: Then ʿUmar (r) came and said: I saw the one who went around with it, but he was ahead of me in it.
translator_notes: The last sentence is obscure; it appears to mean that ʿUmar had seen the same vision but ʿAbd Allāh b. Zayd reported it first. The rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: بَابُ: بَدْءِ الأذَانِ ⦗ص: 152⦘ 181 - حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو مَحْذُورَةَ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» ، وَكَانَ بِلَالٌ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» بِلَالٌ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَأَبُو مَحْذُورَةَ فِي الْحَضَرِ يَعْنِي: فِي آخِرِ الْأَذَانِ
records.isnad_en: ʿĪsā b. al-Musayyab narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: Abū Maḥdhūra used to say: “There is no god but God, and God is greatest,” and Bilāl used to say: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God”—Bilāl on journeys and Abū Maḥdhūra when resident—meaning, at the end of the adhān.
translator_notes: The heading is repeated in the source from the preceding page; the page break [p. 152] falls immediately after it.

groups.title_en: Chapter on the Merit of the Adhān

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَسْمَعُكَ إِنْسٌ وَلَا جِنٌّ وَلَا حَجَرٌ وَلَا شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْأَشْيَاءِ إِلَّا شَهِدَ لَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
records.isnad_en: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Mājishūn narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who said:
records.matn_en: When you give the adhān for prayer, raise your voice; for no human, no jinn, no stone and nothing at all hears you but it will bear witness for you on the Day of Resurrection.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَنْبَسِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: مَنْ أَذَّنَ فَلْيُسْمِعْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ يَشْهَدُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنِ انْتَهَى إِلَيْهِ صَوْتُهُ مِمَّنْ سَمِعَهُ
records.isnad_en: Abū al-ʿAnbas narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Hurayra, who said:
records.matn_en: Whoever gives the adhān, let him make himself heard; for whoever hears him, as far as his voice reaches, will bear witness for him on the Day of Resurrection.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَأَنْ أَقْوَى عَلَى الْأَذَانِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَحُجَّ وَأَعْتَمِرَ وَأُجَاهِدَ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿĀmir, from Saʿd, who said:
records.matn_en: “That I should be strong enough to give the adhān is dearer to me than that I should perform the pilgrimage (ḥajj), the lesser pilgrimage (ʿumra) and fight in jihād.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ ابْنَ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «الْمُؤَذِّنُ الْمُحْتَسِبُ كَالشَّاهِرِ سَيْفَهُ» يَعْنِي فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Jābir, who said: One who heard Ibn al-Ḥanafiyya say narrated to me:
records.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin who seeks reward from God (muḥtasib) is like one who draws his sword”—meaning, in the path of God.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " تُفْتَحُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ لِخَمْسٍ: لِنُزُولِ الْغَيْثِ، وَقِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَلُقِيِّ الزَّحْفِ، وَالنِّدَاءِ بِالصَّلَاةِ، وَالدُّعَاءِ "
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Layth, from Ibn Sābiṭ, who said:
records.matn_en: “The gates of heaven are opened for five: for the coming down of rain, the recitation of the Qurʾān, the meeting of the advancing [enemy] ranks, the call to prayer, and supplication.”
translator_notes: The source has an opening quotation mark and a closing one only after the list.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ كُنْتُ مُؤَذِّنًا مَا بَالَيْتُ أَنْ لَا أَحُجَّ وَلَا أَعْتَمِرَ إِلَّا حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ»
records.isnad_en: al-Waṣṣāfī narrated to us, from Abū Maʿshar, who said: ʿUmar (r) said:
records.matn_en: “If I were a mu’adhdhin I would not mind not performing the pilgrimage or the lesser pilgrimage, except the pilgrimage of Islam.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ كَانَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ نِزَالًا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا غَلَبَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ عَلَى الْأَذَانِ»
records.isnad_en: al-Waṣṣāfī narrated to us, from Abū Maʿshar, who said: ʿUmar (r) said:
records.matn_en: “If the angels were dwelling on earth, no one would surpass them in the adhān.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: لَا يَسْتَحِي رَجُلٌ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنًا
records.isnad_en: Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, who said: ʿUmar (r) said:
records.matn_en: A man should not be ashamed to be a mu’adhdhin.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَى النَّارِ لُحُومُ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ»
records.isnad_en: al-Waṣṣāfī narrated to us, from Abū Maʿshar, who said: ʿUmar said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The flesh of the mu’adhdhins is forbidden to the Fire.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَصَّافِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: " نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ فِي الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ: {وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا} [فصلت: 33] فَأَذَّنَ وَصَلَّى فَهُوَ عَمِلٌ صَالِحٌ
records.isnad_en: al-Waṣṣāfī narrated to us; he said: Muḥammad b. Nāfiʿ narrated to us; he said: ʿĀʾisha said:
records.matn_en: “This verse was revealed concerning the mu’adhdhins: ‘And who is better in speech than one who calls to God and does righteous deeds’ [Q. 41:33]; so he gave the adhān and prayed, and that is a righteous deed.”
translator_notes: The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْهُذَيْلِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: لَوْلَا أَنْ أَخَافَ أَنْ تَكُونَ سُنَّةً مَا تَرَكْتُ الْأَذَانَ "
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Sinān, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī al-Hudhayl, who said: ʿUmar (r) said:
records.matn_en: If I did not fear that it would become a sunna, I would not leave the adhān.
translator_notes: The source has a closing quotation mark and no opening one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «لَوْ أَطَقْتُ الْأَذَانَ بِالْخِلِّيفَى لَأَذَّنْتُ»
records.isnad_en: al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Bayān, from Qays b. Abī Ḥāzim, who said: ʿUmar (r) said:
records.matn_en: “If I were able to give the adhān along with the caliphate (al-khilliyfā), I would give the adhān.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَلْهَمُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَحَانَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الْفِطْرَةُ» فَقَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، قَالَ: «خَلَعَ الْأَنْدَادَ» قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ» ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِإِقَامَتِهِ وَهُوَ لَا يَرَاهُ
records.isnad_en: Dalham b. Ṣāliḥ narrated to us; he said: ʿAwn b. ʿAbd Allāh informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ went out one day from Medina, and the time of prayer came, and he heard a man say: God is greatest. The Prophet ﷺ said: “The natural disposition (al-fiṭra).” He said: I testify that there is no god but God. He said: “He has cast off the equals [set up with God].” He said: I testify that Muḥammad is the Messenger of God. He said: “He has entered Paradise.” Then he prayed with his iqāma, though the man did not see him.
translator_notes: Mursal: ʿAwn b. ʿAbd Allāh does not name a Companion. The last clause is terse and the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَسْتَحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنِيهُمْ فُقَهَاؤُهُمْ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ وَلُّوهُمْ أَمَرَ دِينِهِمْ
records.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abū Ḥamza, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: They used to like their mu’adhdhins to be their jurists, because they had put them in charge of the matter of their religion.

groups.title_en: Chapter on What Is Said When the Mu’adhdhin Gives the Adhān
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَا يُقَالُ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي ابْنَ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم " إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ كَمَا يَقُولُ: حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ: حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، قَالَ: «لَا حَولَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim b. ʿUbayd Allāh, from ʿAlī—Abū Bakr said: meaning Ibn Ḥusayn—from Abū Rāfiʿ, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ “when he heard the mu’adhdhin, would say as he said, until, when he reached: ‘Come to prayer, come to success,’ he said: ‘There is no power and no strength except in God.’”
translator_notes: The source has an opening quotation mark before ‘when he heard’ and a closing mark only after the final words.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مِنَ الْجَفَاءِ أَنْ لَا تَقُولَ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from al-Musayyab b. Rāfiʿ, from ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
records.matn_en: “It is among the coarseness (jafāʾ) not to say the like of what the mu’adhdhin says.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ: «وَأَنَا وَأَنَا»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām b. ʿUrwa, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ, when he heard the mu’adhdhin, would say: ‘And I, and I.’”
translator_notes: Mursal: Hishām b. ʿUrwa does not name a Companion. The source has an opening quotation mark before the whole report.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَبَطَ مِنْ مَدَارِجِ التَّمْرِ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ، فَعَرَّسَ، فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ بِلَالٌ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ»
records.isnad_en: ʿUmar b. Dharr narrated to us, from Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar b. Saʿd,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ came down from Madārij al-Tamr between Mecca and Medina and made a night camp, and Bilāl gave the adhān; and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever says the like of what Bilāl said, from himself (min nafsihi), God will forbid him to the Fire.”

narrators.en: Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar b. Saʿd

translator_notes: Mursal: Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ does not name a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَمِّعُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حَنِيفٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَبَّرَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَكَبِّرِ اثْنَتَيْنِ، وَإِذَا شَهِدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ اثْنَتَيْنِ اشْهَدِ اثْنَتَيْنِ، وَإِذَا شَهِدَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ اثْنَتَيْنِ اشْهَدِ اثْنَتَيْنِ» ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَيَّ فَقَالَ: هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْأَذَانِ
records.isnad_en: Mujammiʿ b. Yaḥyā narrated to us; he said: Abū Umāma b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf narrated to me; he said: I heard Muʿāwiya say:
records.matn_en: “When the mu’adhdhin says the takbīr twice, say the takbīr twice; and when he testifies that there is no god but God twice, testify twice; and when he testifies that Muḥammad is the Messenger of God twice, testify twice.” Then he turned to me and said: Thus I heard the Prophet ﷺ say at the adhān.

narrators.en: Abū Umāma b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِيَ يَقُولُ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، قَالَ: «وَأَنَا وَأَنَا» وَإِذَا قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «وَأَنَا» ثُمَّ سَكَتَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Abū Jaʿfar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ, when he heard the caller say: “I testify that there is no god but God,” said: “And I, and I”; and when he said: “I testify that Muḥammad is the Messenger of God,” he said: “And I”; then he fell silent.
translator_notes: Mursal: Abū Jaʿfar does not name a Companion.

groups.title_en: Chapter on Taking Payment for the Adhān

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ يُقَالُ: " أَرْبَعُ لَا يُؤْخَذُ عَلَيْهِنَّ رِزْقًا: الْقُرْآنُ، وَالْأَذَانُ، وَالْقَضَاءُ، وَالْمَقَاسِمُ "
records.isnad_en: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from al-Qāsim, who said:
records.matn_en: It used to be said: “Four things for which no stipend is taken: the Qurʾān, the adhān, judging (qaḍāʾ), and the division of shares (maqāsim).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ زَاذَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى الْبُكَّاءِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَطُوفُ مَعَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَهُوَ آخِذٌ بِيَدِي، فَمَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مُؤَذِّنِي الْكَعْبَةَ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي لَأُبْغضُكَ فِي اللَّهِ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ يُحَسِّنُ صَوْتَهُ؛ لِأَخْذِ الدَّرَاهِمِ
records.isnad_en: ʿUmāra b. Zādhān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā al-Bakkāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: I was circumambulating with Saʿīd b. Jubayr, who was holding my hand, when Ibn ʿUmar passed, and a man from among the mu’adhdhins of the Kaʿba met him, and he said: I hate you for God’s sake. He said: He beautifies his voice in order to take dirhams.
translator_notes: The speakers are not clearly marked in the source; the rendering is tentative.

groups.title_en: Chapter on the Adhān of the Blind Man, and Those Who Disliked It and Those Who Permitted It
groups.title_ar: بَابُ أَذَانِ الْأَعْمَى وَمَنْ كَرِهَهُ وَمَنْ رَخَّصَ فِيهِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الْأَحْدَبِ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ بُرْمَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: " مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنُوكُمْ عِمْيَانَكُمْ، قَالَ: وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ: وَلَا قُرَّاؤُكُمْ "
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Wāṣil al-Aḥdab, from Qabīṣa b. Burma, who said: ʿAbd Allāh said:
records.matn_en: “I do not like your mu’adhdhins to be your blind men”—he (Qabīṣa) said: and I think he said: “nor your reciters (qurrāʾ).”
translator_notes: The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» ⦗ص: 164⦘ قَالَ: وَكَانَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ رَجُلًا أَعْمَى، لَا يُؤَذِّنُ حَتَّى يَقُولُ لَهُ النَّاسُ: أَذِّنْ، أَصْبَحْتَ
records.isnad_en: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Mājishūn narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Bilāl gives the adhān at night, so eat and drink until you hear the adhān of Ibn Umm Maktūm.” [p. 164] He said: And Ibn Umm Maktūm was a blind man who would not give the adhān until the people said to him: Give the adhān; it is morning.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْأَذَانَ فِي الْمَنَامِ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَأَمَرَ بِلَالًا فَأَذَّنَ
records.isnad_en: Zakariyyāʾ b. Abī Zāʾida narrated to us, from al-Shaʿbī, who said:
records.matn_en: ʿAbd Allāh b. Zayd saw the adhān in a dream, and he came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him, and he ordered Bilāl, who gave the adhān.
translator_notes: Mursal: al-Shaʿbī does not name a Companion as his source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ ⦗ص: 165⦘ الْغُلَامُ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from ʿAṭāʾ,
records.matn_en: that he “disliked that a boy give the adhān [p. 165] before he has had a wet dream (yaḥtalim).”

groups.title_en: Chapter on the Adhān Without Ablution

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ مُؤَذِّنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يُؤَذِّنُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ "
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Manṣūr, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibrāhīm’s mu’adhdhin used to give the adhān without being in a state of ablution.
translator_notes: The source has a stray closing quotation mark.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَافَرْتُ مَعَ مُجَاهِدٍ فَكُنْتُ مُؤَذِّنَهُمْ، فَقَالَ لِي مُجَاهِدٌ: لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى تَتَوَضَّأَ
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Thuwayr, who said:
records.matn_en: I travelled with Mujāhid and I was their mu’adhdhin, and Mujāhid said to me: Do not give the adhān until you have performed ablution.

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Does Not Speak During His Adhān
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي أَذَانِهِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلٌّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ، حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ أَذَانِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Muḥill narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “He disliked speaking until he had finished his adhān.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِي أَذَانِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin does not speak during his adhān.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ، عَنْ جَامِعِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي ⦗ص: 168⦘ صَخْرَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ صُرَدَ، كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي الْعَسْكَرِ فَيَأْمُرُ غُلَامَهُ بِالْحَاجَةِ وَهُوَ فِي أَذَانِهِ
records.isnad_en: Muḥammad b. Ṭalḥa b. Muṣarrif narrated to us, from Jāmiʿ b. Shaddād Abū [p. 168] Ṣakhra, from Mūsā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Yazīd,
records.matn_en: that Sulaymān b. Ṣurad used to give the adhān in the army camp and would order his servant [to see to] a need while he was in the midst of his adhān.

narrators.en: Mūsā b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Yazīd

translator_notes: The page break [p. 168] falls in the middle of the name Abū Ṣakhra in the source.

groups.title_en: Chapter: The Mu’adhdhin Puts His Two Fingers in His Ears
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي الْمُؤَذِّنِ يَجْعَلُ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ أَبِي أَسَدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ تُدْخِلَ إِصْبَعَيْكَ فِي أُذُنَيْكَ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Sinān, from Sahl Abū Asad, who said:
records.matn_en: “It is part of the sunna that you put your two fingers in your ears.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعْدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ غَفَلَةَ «يُدْخِلُ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ»
records.isnad_en: Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ narrated to us, from Abū Saʿd, who said:
records.matn_en: I saw Suwayd b. Ghafala “put his two fingers in his ears.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ: أَضَعُ أُصْبُعَيَّ فِي أُذُنِي إِذَا أَذَّنْتُ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، كِلَاهُمَا أَوْ إِحْدَاهُمَا يُجْزِئُكَ»
records.isnad_en: Ḥabbān narrated to us, from Mujālid, from al-Shaʿbī, who said:
records.matn_en: I said: May I put my two fingers in my ears when I give the adhān? He said: “Yes; both of them, or one of them, suffices you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ «إِذَا أَذَّنَ جَعَلَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ أَوْ عَلَى أُذُنَيْهِ»
records.isnad_en: Mindal narrated to us, from Jaʿfar b. Abī al-Mughīra, who said:
records.matn_en: Saʿīd b. Jubayr, “when he gave the adhān, would put his two fingers in his ears or over his ears.”

records.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ شَرِيكًا، قِيلَ لَهُ: يَجْعَلُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ إِصْبَعَهُ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ»
records.isnad_en: I heard Sharīk, when it was said to him: Does the mu’adhdhin put his finger in his ears?
records.matn_en: He said: “Yes.”
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» وَكَانَ رَجُلًا أَعْمَى لَا يُؤَذِّنُ حَتَّى يَقُولَ لَهُ النَّاسُ: أَذِّنْ، أَصْبَحْتَ
records.isnad_en: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Mājishūn narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Bilāl gives the adhān at night, so eat and drink until you hear the adhān of Ibn Umm Maktūm.” And he was a blind man who would not give the adhān until the people said to him: Give the adhān; it is morning.

narrators.en: Sālim b. ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿUmar

translator_notes: This repeats no. 205 with a slightly different chain.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: «مَا كَانُوا يُؤَذِّنُونَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحُوا»
records.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
records.matn_en: “They did not give the adhān until it was morning.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ شَدَّادٍ، - مَوْلَى عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ بِلَالًا، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُؤْذِنُهُ بِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، فَقَالَ: «يَا بِلَالُ، لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى تَنْظُرَ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ هَكَذَا» ، وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ قَالَ أَبُو ⦗ص: 171⦘ بَكْرٍ: رَوَى وَكِيع أَوْ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ: «لَا تُؤَذِّنْ بِالْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَنْظُرَ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ هَكَذَا كَمَا يَشُقُّ الْخَيَّاطُ الثَّوْبَ» 7
records.isnad_en: Jaʿfar b. Burqān narrated to us, from Shaddād—freedman of ʿIyāḍ b. ʿĀmir—who said:
records.matn_en: It reached me that Bilāl came to the Prophet ﷺ to inform him of the dawn prayer, and he said: “O Bilāl, do not give the adhān until you see the dawn like this,” and he gestured with his hand. Abū [p. 171] Bakr said: Wakīʿ or another narrated: “Do not give the adhān for the dawn until you see the dawn like this, as the tailor splits the cloth.”
translator_notes: Mursal and with a transmitter’s ‘it reached me’. The page break [p. 171] falls in the middle of the name Abū Bakr in the source. A stray numeral 7 follows the end of the report in the source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ بِلَيْلٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ارْجِعْ إِلَى مَقَامِكَ فَنَادِ ثَلَاثًا: أَلَا إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ نَامَ " قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَ بِلَالًا لَمْ تَلِدْهُ أُمُّهُ، وَابْتَلَّ مِنْ نَضْحِ جَبِينِهِ، فَانْطَلَقَ فَنَادَى بِهَا ثَلَاثًا: أَلَا إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ نَامَ
records.isnad_en: Sulaymān b. al-Mughīra narrated to us, from Ḥumayd b. Hilāl, who said:
records.matn_en: Bilāl gave the adhān at night, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Go back to your place and call out three times: ‘Indeed, the servant has slept.’” He said: So he went off, saying: O that Bilāl’s mother had not borne him!—and he was drenched with the sweat of his brow; then he went and called it out three times: Indeed, the servant has slept.
translator_notes: Mursal: Ḥumayd b. Hilāl does not name a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ أَبُو عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّعْرَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: «لَا تُؤَذِّنْ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ»
records.isnad_en: Ḥafṣ Abū ʿAmr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zaʿrāʾ, from Abū al-Aḥwaṣ,
records.matn_en: that he said to his mu’adhdhin: “Do not give the adhān until dawn has risen.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو، صَاحِبُ الْقُمُصِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْأَسْوَدِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَذَّنْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ، فَجَاءَ قَيْسُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ بِعَصًا فَضَرَبَنِي»
records.isnad_en: Abū ʿAmr, the man of the shirts (ṣāḥib al-qumuṣ), narrated to us; he said: Abū al-Aswad al-Hamdānī narrated to me; he said:
records.matn_en: “I gave the adhān before dawn had risen, and Qays b. Abī Ḥāzim came with a staff and struck me.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَا تُؤَذِّنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُهَا
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Muḥammad b. Sālim, from ʿĀmir, who said:
records.matn_en: Do not give the adhān for a prayer until its time has entered.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ لِعَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه مُؤَذِّنٌ، فَجَعَلَ مَعَهُ مُؤَذِّنًا آخَرَ؛ لِكَيْ لَا يُؤَذِّنَ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الْفَجْرُ
records.isnad_en: Abū Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Fuḍayl b. ʿAmr, who said:
records.matn_en: ʿAlī (r) had a mu’adhdhin, and he appointed another mu’adhdhin with him, in order that he would not give the adhān until the dawn had burst forth.

groups.title_en: Chapter on Measured Delivery (tarassul) in the Adhān

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَطَّارُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، - مُؤَذِّنِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: جَاءَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَذَّنْتَ فَتَرَسَّلْ»
records.isnad_en: Marḥūm b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to us; he said: My father narrated to me, from Abū al-Zubayr—mu’adhdhin of Bayt al-Maqdis—who said:
records.matn_en: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb (r) came to us and said: “When you give the adhān, pace yourself (tarassal).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُرَتِّلُ فِي الْأَذَانِ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Zurʿa, from Ibn ʿUmar,
records.matn_en: that he “used to deliver the adhān in a measured way (yurattil).”

groups.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Used to Rush the Iqāma (yaḥdhim)

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، - مُؤَذِّنِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: جَاءَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَقَمْتَ فَاحْدُرْ»
records.isnad_en: Marḥūm b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us; he said: My father informed me, from Abū al-Zubayr—mu’adhdhin of Bayt al-Maqdis—who said:
records.matn_en: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb (r) came to us and said: “When you give the iqāma, speed up (iḥdur).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَحْذِمُ الْإِقَامَةَ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿUthmān b. Abī al-Mughīra, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Ibn ʿUmar,
records.matn_en: that he “used to rush through the iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ «يَحْذِمُ الْإِقَامَةَ»
records.isnad_en: Misʿar narrated to us, from Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿUmar “used to rush through the iqāma.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Used to Double the Adhān (yuthannī)
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ كَانَ يُثَنِّي الْأَذَانَ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ، «فَكَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to us; he said:
records.matn_en: I accompanied Ibn ʿUmar from Medina to Mecca, “and when he gave the adhān he would double [its phrases].”

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي قَائِدُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، أَنَّهُ «كَانَ أَذَانُهُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى»
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, who said:
records.matn_en: The guide of Abū Maḥdhūra informed me that “his adhān was in pairs (mathnā mathnā).”
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَافَرْتُ مَعَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ «فَكَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
records.matn_en: I travelled with Saʿīd b. Jubayr, “and when he gave the adhān he would double [its phrases].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُؤَذِّنِ،
records.matn_ar: عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه «كَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ثَنَّى»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Thuwayr, from his father, from the mu’adhdhin of ʿAlī (r):
records.matn_en: “When he gave the adhān he would double [its phrases].”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Whose Adhān Ended with “There Is No God but God”
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, who said:
records.matn_en: “The end of Abū Maḥdhūra’s adhān was: There is no god but God.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ - مُؤَذِّنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ
records.matn_ar: «آخِرَ الْأَذَانِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»
records.isnad_en: Yūnus b. Abī Isḥāq narrated to us, from Muḥārib b. Dithār, who said: al-Aswad b. Yazīd narrated to me, that Abū Maḥdhūra—mu’adhdhin of the Messenger of God ﷺ—narrated to him that:
records.matn_en: “The end of the adhān is: There is no god but God.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبِي، فَصَلَّى مَعَنَا الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مَعَ أَبِي يَمْشِيَانِ وَأَنَا مَعَهُمَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي: يَا أَبَا عِمْرَانَ، أَيُّهُمَا آخِرُ الْأَذَانِ؟ فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»
records.isnad_en: ʿUmar b. Dharr narrated to us; he said:
records.matn_en: Ibrāhīm came to my father and prayed al-ʿAṣr with us; then he went out with my father, the two of them walking and I with them, and my father said to him: O Abū ʿImrān, which of them is the end of the adhān? Ibrāhīm said: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ، إِذَا أَذَّنَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: يَعْنِي يَخْتِمُ أَذَانَهُ
records.isnad_en: Kāmil Abū al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us; he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ; he said: I heard Abū Maḥdhūra, when he gave the adhān, say:
records.matn_en: “God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.” Abū Nuʿaym said: He means that he would end his adhān [with it].

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي قَائِدُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ خَاتِمَةُ أَذَانِهِ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Rufayʿ, who said: The guide of Abū Maḥdhūra informed me, from Abū Maḥdhūra:
records.matn_en: that “the conclusion of his adhān was: God is greatest, God is greatest; there is no god but God.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Whose Adhān Ended with “God Is Greatest”
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ أَذَانِهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فَكَانَ مُؤَذِّنُنَا، وَكَانَ يَجْعَلُ آخِرَ أَذَانِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ "
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
records.matn_en: “I accompanied Ibn ʿUmar from Mecca to Medina, and he was our mu’adhdhin, and he would make the end of his adhān: There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آخِرِ الْأَذَانِ، قَالَ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me; he said:
records.matn_en: I asked Abū Jaʿfar about the end of the adhān; he said: “There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ إِلَى مُؤَذِّنِنَا رِيَاحٍ فَقَالَ: «قُلْ لَهُ يَخْتِمُ أَذَانَهُ بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، فَإِنَّهُ أَذَانُ بِلَالٍ»
records.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from ʿImrān b. Muslim, who said:
records.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala sent me to our mu’adhdhin Riyāḥ and said: “Tell him to end his adhān with ‘There is no god but God and God is greatest,’ for it is the adhān of Bilāl.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ثُوَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُؤَذِّنِ،
records.matn_ar: عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ " كَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ جَعَلَ آخِرَ أَذَانِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ "
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to me, from his father, from the mu’adhdhin of ʿAlī (r),
records.matn_en: that “when he gave the adhān he would make the end of his adhān: There is no god but God, and God is greatest.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on “Prayer Is Better Than Sleep”: Those Who Used to Say It in the Dawn Prayer
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، مَنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " كَانَ فِي الْأَذَانِ الْأَوَّلِ بَعْدَ الْفَلَاحِ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ "
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said:
records.matn_en: “In the first adhān, after ‘Come to success,’ there was: Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ، "
records.matn_ar: إِذَا أَذَّنَ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ "
records.isnad_en: Kāmil narrated to us; he said: I heard Abū Ṣāliḥ; he said: I heard Abū Maḥdhūra,
records.matn_en: “when he gave the adhān—‘Come to prayer, come to success’—[say]: ‘Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.’”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْفَرَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Jaʿfar al-Farrāʾ, from Abū Salmān, from Abū Maḥdhūra, that he used to say:
records.matn_en: “Come to prayer, come to success, prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَيْسَانُ مَوْلَى هِشَامٍ الْقُرْدُوسِيِّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِيرِينَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ»
records.isnad_en: Kaysān, freedman of Hishām al-Qurdūsī, narrated to us; he said: I heard Muḥammad b. Sīrīn say:
records.matn_en: “‘Prayer is better than sleep’ is [said] in the adhān of the dawn.”

records.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ، يَقُولُ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ بَعْدَ الْفَلَاحِ:
records.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ»
records.isnad_en: I heard Sufyān say, concerning the adhān of the dawn, after ‘Come to success’:
records.matn_en: “Prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَهِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " جَاءَ بِلَالٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لِيَؤْذِنَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَوَجَدَهُ نَائِمًا فَقَالَ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فَتُرِكَتْ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَا اخْتَلَفَا فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَنْطِقِ
records.isnad_en: Ḥafṣ narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from al-Ḥasan, and Hishām, from his father—he said:
records.matn_en: “Bilāl came to the Prophet ﷺ to inform him of the prayer, and found him asleep, and said: Prayer is better than sleep; so it was left [in place] in the dawn prayer—unless the two [reports] differ on some point of wording.”
translator_notes: Mursal. The last clause is terse and its rendering is tentative; the source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَمِعَ الْأَسْوَدُ، مُؤَذِّنًا يَقُولُ: الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ، بَعْدَمَا (. . .) فَقَالَ: " وَيْحَكَ، لَا تَزْوِيْدَ فِي أَذَانِ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ، قَالَ: «فَلَا تَقُلْ»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Ḥakīm b. Jubayr, from ʿImrān b. Abī al-Jaʿd, who said:
records.matn_en: al-Aswad heard a mu’adhdhin say “Prayer is better than sleep,” after (. . .); and he said: “Woe to you! Do not add anything to God’s adhān.” He said: I heard the people say it. He said: “Then do not say it.”
translator_notes: The source has an ellipsis after ‘after’, marking omitted words, and an unusual spelling of the word for ‘add’.

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Used to Make the Tathwīb in the Dawn [Prayer]
groups.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ يُثَوِّبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ بِلَالٌ «يَحُثُّ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
records.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlā, from Suwayd b. Ghafala, who said:
records.matn_en: Bilāl “used to urge [the people] on (yaḥuththu) at the dawn [prayer].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «التَّثْوِيبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ»
records.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abū Ḥamza, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “The tathwīb at the dawn [prayer] is part of the sunna.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ بِلَالٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُثَوِّبُ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿImrān b. Muslim, from Suwayd, from Bilāl,
records.matn_en: that he “used to make the tathwīb at the dawn [prayer].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانُوا يَثُوبُونَ فِي الْفَجْرِ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Zubayd, from Khaythama, who said:
records.matn_en: “They used to make the tathwīb at the dawn [prayer].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: مَا أَحْدَثُوا بِدْعَةً أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنَ التَّثْوِيبِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from one who heard ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, who said:
records.matn_en: They have not introduced an innovation (bidʿa) dearer to me than the tathwīb in the prayer.

narrators.en: one who heard ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ إِلَى مُؤَذِّنِنَا - رِيَاحٍ - فَقَالَ: قُلْ إِذَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَوْ قَبِيلَ الْإِقَامَةِ فَلْيَقُلْ: حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَذَانُ بِلَالٍ
records.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from ʿImrān b. Muslim, who said:
records.matn_en: Suwayd b. Ghafala sent me to our mu’adhdhin—Riyāḥ—and said: Say [to him]: When it is before—or shortly before—the iqāma, let him say: “Come to prayer, come to prayer, come to success,” for it is the adhān of Bilāl.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ⦗ص: 188⦘ النَّوْمِ هُوَ التَّثْوِيبُ»
records.isnad_en: Jarīr narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ḥammād, who said:
records.matn_en: “‘Prayer is better than [p. 188] sleep’ is the tathwīb.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَزَّةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانَ عَامِرٌ يَأْمُرُ مُؤَذِّنَهُ أَنْ لَا يُثَوِّبَ إِلَّا فِي الْفَجْرِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from ʿĪsā b. Abī ʿAzza, who said:
records.matn_en: “ʿĀmir used to order his mu’adhdhin not to make the tathwīb except at the dawn [prayer] and al-ʿIshāʾ.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا كَامِلٌ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ «يُثَوِّبُ فِي كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»
records.isnad_en: Kāmil Abū al-ʿAlāʾ narrated to us; he said:
records.matn_en: Abū Ṣāliḥ “used to make the tathwīb at every prayer.”

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُدَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ وَيُقِيمَ، قَالَ: يَرْجِعُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Kudayna narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ibrāhīm, who said, concerning the man who wishes to delay and give the iqāma:
records.matn_en: He said: “He goes back.”
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.
translator_notes: The saying is terse and the rendering is tentative; the source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِلشَّعْبِيِّ: حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ، قَالَ: هَلُمَّ
records.isnad_en: Ḥabbān narrated to us, from Mujālid, who said:
records.matn_en: I said to al-Shaʿbī: “Come to success”; he said: Halumma (“Come”).
translator_notes: The question is not fully spelled out in the source; it appears to ask the meaning of ‘ḥayya ʿalā al-falāḥ’.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلٌّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الْإِقَامَتَيْنِ دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي إِذَا قَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ مَرَّتَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْإِمَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنَ الْإِقَامَةِ
records.isnad_en: Muḥill narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “When he had finished the two [phrases of the] iqāma, he entered the prayer.” Abū Bakr said: He means: when the mu’adhdhin said “The prayer has been established” twice, the imām entered the prayer before the mu’adhdhin had finished the iqāma.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " كَانَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ جُلَّ مَا يَصْنَعُ أَنْ يُكَبِّرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ: قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ "
records.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from ʿImrān b. Muslim, who said:
records.matn_en: “Most of what Suwayd b. Ghafala did was to say the takbīr before the mu’adhdhin said: The prayer has been established.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Is Present in the Mosque [When the Adhān Is Called]

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ هَمْدَانَ - قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ سَعْدٌ: إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنُودِيَ بِالْأَذَانِ فَلَا تَخْرُجْ
records.isnad_en: Misʿar narrated to us, from Abū ʿAwn, from Shurayḥ—a man from Hamdān—who said: Saʿd said:
records.matn_en: When you are in the mosque and the adhān is called, do not go out.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: رَأَى أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ رَجُلًا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ مَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَالَ: أَمَّا هَذَا، فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
records.isnad_en: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from Ashʿath b. Abī al-Shaʿthāʾ, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: Abū Hurayra saw a man go out of the mosque after the mu’adhdhin had given the adhān, and he said: As for this one, he has disobeyed Abū al-Qāsim ﷺ.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «مَنْ سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِي فَخَرَجَ فَهُوَ مُنَافِقٌ، إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ فِي حَاجَةٍ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Ḥarmala, from Saʿīd b. al-Musayyab, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever hears the caller and goes out is a hypocrite, except a man who goes out for a need and then returns.”
translator_notes: Mursal: Saʿīd b. al-Musayyab does not name a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا سَمِعْتَ الْإِقَامَةَ، فَلَا تَخْرُجْ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “When you hear the iqāma, do not go out.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on the Man Who Comes to the Mosque After They Have Prayed
groups.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلُّوا

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلُّوا، قَالَ: «يُقِيمُ»
records.isnad_en: Jaʿfar b. Burqān narrated to us; he said:
records.matn_en: I asked al-Zuhrī about the man who comes to the mosque after they have prayed; he said: “He gives the iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا صَلَّى فِي الْمَسْجِدِ جَمَاعَةٌ، فَإِنَّ إِقَامَتَهُمْ تُجْزِئُ عَنْ مَنْ صَلَّى إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ: إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ الْأُخْرَى
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Ashʿath b. Sulaym, who said: I heard al-Shaʿbī say:
records.matn_en: “If a congregation has prayed in the mosque, their iqāma suffices for whoever prays [thereafter] until the [next] prayer.” Abū Bakr said: I think he said: until the other prayer.

groups.title_en: Chapter: When You Go Out into a Desolate Tract of Land (qiyy)
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فِي قِيٍّ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا خَرَجْتَ قِيًّا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، أَوْ فِي قِيٍّ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، فَتَخَيَّرْ وَأَذِّنْ وَأَقِمْ، أَوْ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَقِمْ»
records.isnad_en: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿĀṣim b. Ḍamra, from ʿAlī (r), who said:
records.matn_en: “When you go out into a desolate tract of land, or into a desolate tract of land, you have a choice: give the adhān and give the iqāma, or, if you wish, give the iqāma [only].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Salama b. Kuhayl, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar,
records.matn_en: that he “prayed al-Maghrib and al-ʿIshāʾ at Jamʿ with a single iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَذِّنْ وَأَقِمْ، وَإِنْ أَقَمْتَ أَجْزَأَكَ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿĀṣim, from ʿAlī (r), who said:
records.matn_en: “Give the adhān and the iqāma; and if you give the iqāma [only], it suffices you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، «صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ⦗ص: 194⦘ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ، وَذَلِكَ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ»
records.isnad_en: ʿUmar b. Dharr narrated to us, from Mujāhid,
records.matn_en: that Ibn ʿUmar “prayed al-Maghrib [p. 194] and al-ʿIshāʾ at Jamʿ, and that was with a single iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: اتَّفَقَ عَلِيٌّ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّ «كُلَّ صَلَاةٍ بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ بِجَمْعٍ»
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Jaʿfar, who said:
records.matn_en: ʿAlī and ʿAbd Allāh agreed that “every prayer at Jamʿ is with an adhān and an iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْبَصْرِيُّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ سَالِمٍ بِجَمْعٍ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِإِقَامَتَيْنِ»
records.isnad_en: Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Baṣrī, who said:
records.matn_en: “I prayed behind Sālim at Jamʿ, al-Maghrib and al-ʿIshāʾ, with two iqāmas.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَقِيتُ نَافِعًا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: كَيْفَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَصْنَعُ؟ قَالَ: هَكَذَا
records.isnad_en: Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm, who said:
records.matn_en: I met Nāfiʿ and said to him: How did ʿAbd Allāh used to do it? He said: Like this.
translator_notes: ‘ʿAbd Allāh’ is presumably Ibn ʿUmar, Nāfiʿ’s master.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ لِنَفْسِكَ أَجْزَأَكَ إِقَامَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
records.isnad_en: Ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh b. Abī Yazīd, who said: I heard Jābir b. Zayd say:
records.matn_en: When you pray for yourself, a single iqāma suffices you.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا دَلْهَمُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ⦗ص: 195⦘ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَسَمِعَ مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَنَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ، وَهُوَ لَا يَرَاهُ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنْ تِلْكَ الشِّعَابِ فِي غَنَمِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Dalham b. Ṣāliḥ narrated to us; he said: ʿAwn b. ʿAbd Allāh informed me, [p. 195] he said:
records.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ went out one day from Medina and heard a caller calling to prayer; so the Messenger of God ﷺ dismounted and led his Companions in prayer, while the caller did not see him, in one of those ravines, among his sheep.”
translator_notes: Mursal: ʿAwn b. ʿAbd Allāh does not name a Companion. The report is terse and the rendering of its last clause is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: " صَلَّيْتُ فِي السَّفَرِ بِغَيْرِ إِقَامَةٍ، قَالَ: يُجْزِئُكَ "
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, who said:
records.matn_en: I said to Ibrāhīm: “I prayed on a journey without an iqāma.” He said: “It suffices you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةٌ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: “He does not have to repeat.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: He Repeats

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «يُعِيدُ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl b. Umayya, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: “He repeats.”

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: يُعِيدُ
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: He repeats.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَا صَلَاةَ ⦗ص: 197⦘ إِلَّا بِإِقَامَةٍ
records.isnad_en: Ṭalḥa b. ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: There is no prayer [p. 197] except with an iqāma.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا بِالْإِقَامَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Baṣrī, from ʿAṭāʾ, who said:
records.matn_en: “There is no prayer except with the iqāma.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Prayed in His House
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ صَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «رُبَّمَا صَلَّى إِبْرَاهِيمُ فِي بَيْتِهِ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَلَا إِقَامَةٍ»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir, who said:
records.matn_en: “Ibrāhīm sometimes prayed in his house without an adhān or an iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي مِصْرٍ يُؤَذَّنُ فِيهِ أَوْ يُقَامُ، فَإِنَّ إِقَامَتَهُمْ تُجْزِئُكَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, from Ḥuṣayn, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “If you are in a town (miṣr) in which the adhān is called or the iqāma is given, their iqāma suffices you.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ «لَا يُقِيمُ فِي أَرْضٍ تُقَامُ فِيهِ الصَّلَاةُ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from ʿIkrima b. Khālid, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Wāqid, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn ʿUmar “would not give the iqāma in a place in which the prayer was [already] being held.”

groups.title_en: Chapter: The Mu’adhdhin Has More Right to the Adhān and the Imām Has More Right to the Iqāma
groups.title_ar: بَابُ الْمُؤَذِّنِ أَمْلَكُ بِالْأَذَانِ وَالْإِمَامُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْإِقَامَةِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَوْ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، هَكَذَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه:
records.matn_ar: «الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْأَذَانِ وَالْإِمَامُ أَمْلَكُ بِالْإِقَامَةِ» ⦗ص: 200⦘
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Hilāl b. Yasāf, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, or from Saʿd b. ʿUbayda, from Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān—thus Sufyān said—from ʿAlī (r), who said:
records.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin has more right to the adhān, and the imām has more right to the iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، (. . .)
records.matn_ar: يَنْظُرُ الْإِمَامُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ (. . .) الْمُؤَذِّنِ
records.isnad_en: [p. 200] Qays narrated to us, from Muḥammad b. (. . .),
records.matn_en: (. . .) the imām considers what is between him and (. . .) the mu’adhdhin.
translator_notes: The source is fragmentary, with ellipses marking omitted words; the rendering is tentative.

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، (. . .) مِثْلَهُ
records.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, (. . .)
records.matn_en: the like of it.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.
translator_notes: The source has an ellipsis in the chain.

groups.title_en: Chapter on People Waiting for the Imām Standing
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ الْإِمَامَ قِيَامًا

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِيْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةُ»
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā b. Abī Kathīr, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī Qatāda, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When the prayer has been established, do not stand until you see me, and keep to calm (sakīna).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ زَائِدَةَ بْنِ نَشِيطٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْوَالِبِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عَلِيٌّ وَقَدْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَهُمْ قِيَامٌ، فَقَالَ: «مَا لَكُمْ سَامِدِينَ؟»
records.isnad_en: ʿImrān b. Zāʾida b. Nashīṭ narrated to us; he said: My father informed me, from Abū Khālid al-Wālibī, who said:
records.matn_en: ʿAlī came out to us when the prayer had been established and they were standing, and he said: “What is the matter with you, standing stock-still (sāmidīn)?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، (. . .) عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ الْقَوْمُ يَنْتَظِرُونَ الْإِمَامَ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، وَكَانَ يُقَالُ هُوَ السُّمُودُ
records.isnad_en: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ narrated to us, (. . .) from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “He disliked that the people stand waiting for the imām when the prayer had been established; and it used to be said: That is sumūd.”
translator_notes: The source has an ellipsis in the chain, and an opening quotation mark with no closing one.

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ بْنِ نَشِيطٍ، عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْوَالِبِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضي الله عنه مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عِمْرَانَ
records.isnad_en: Fiṭr narrated to us, from Zāʾida b. Nashīṭ, from Abū Khālid al-Wālibī, from ʿAlī (r),
records.matn_en: the like of the ḥadīth of ʿImrān.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Gave the Adhān and [Then] Led the Prayer

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثُوَيْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي سَفَرٍ، وَكَانَ مُؤَذِّنَنَا وَإِمَامَنَا
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us; he said: Thuwayr narrated to us; he said:
records.matn_en: I accompanied Ibn ʿUmar on a journey, and he was our mu’adhdhin and our imām.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: لَوْ أَطَقْتُ الْأَذَانَ أَوِ التَّأْذِينَ بِالْخِلِّيفَى لَأَذَّنْتُ
records.isnad_en: Ḥasan narrated to us, from Bayān, from Qays b. Abī Ḥāzim, who said: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb (r) said:
records.matn_en: If I were able to give the adhān—or the call (ta’dhīn)—along with the caliphate (al-khilliyfā), I would give the adhān.
translator_notes: Compare no. 193.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ غَفَلَةَ: «لَوِ اسْتَطَعْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُؤَذِّنَ الْحَيِّ لَفَعَلْتُ»
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿImrān, who said: Suwayd b. Ghafala said:
records.matn_en: “If I could be the mu’adhdhin of the neighbourhood, I would do so.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، (. . .) قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِمَامًا وَمُؤَذِّنًا ⦗ص: 204⦘
records.isnad_en: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿImrān, (. . .) he said:
records.matn_en: “It is part of the sunna that one be both imām and mu’adhdhin.”
translator_notes: The source has an ellipsis in the chain.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا (. . .) عَنْ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَذَّنَ لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَأَقَامَ
records.isnad_en: [p. 204] (. . .) narrated to us, from Abū Ṭuʿma, who said:
records.matn_en: I was with Ibn ʿUmar on a journey, and he gave the adhān for al-Maghrib and gave the iqāma.
translator_notes: The first link of the chain is omitted in the source (ellipsis).

groups.title_en: Chapter on One Who Gave the Adhān on His Mount
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي مَنْ أَذَّنَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ

records.text_ar: (. . .) 300 - عَنْ نُسِيرٍ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يُؤَذِّنُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ نَزَلَ 301 - حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي طُعْمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَهُ
records.text_en: [300] (. . .) from Nusayr Abū Ṭuʿma, who said: I saw Ibn ʿUmar give the adhān on his mount, and when he wished to give the iqāma he dismounted. [301] Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Ṭuʿma, from Ibn ʿUmar, the like of it.
records.no_isnad_reason: Several reports share this source record; they are shown together, as the source prints them.
translator_notes: The source begins this record with an ellipsis marking omitted words.

groups.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: There Is No Adhān and No Iqāma for Women
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي مَنْ قَالَ لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ أَذَانٌ وَلَا إِقَامَةٌ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا (. . .) عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «عَلَيْهِنَّ إِقَامَةٌ يَعْنِي النِّسَاءَ»
records.isnad_en: (. . .) narrated to us, from ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad, from Mujāhid, who said:
records.matn_en: “The iqāma is required of them”—meaning, women.
translator_notes: The first link of the chain is omitted in the source (ellipsis).

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، «كَانَتْ تُؤَذِّنُ وَتُقِيمُ»
records.isnad_en: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿĀmir,
records.matn_en: that ʿĀʾisha “used to give the adhān and the iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ جُمَيْعٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي جَدَّتِي، عَنْ أُمِّ وَرَقَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: «أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَؤُمَّ أَهْلَ دَارِهَا، وَكَانَ لَهَا مُؤَذِّنٌ»
records.isnad_en: al-Walīd b. Jumayʿ narrated to us; he said: My grandmother narrated to me, from Umm Waraqa bt. ʿAbd Allāh,
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ “ordered her to lead the people of her house in prayer, and she had a mu’adhdhin.”

groups.title_en: Chapter on Those Who Said: The Mu’adhdhin Sits Between the Adhān and the Iqāma
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: فِي مَنْ قَالَ: يَقْعُدُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ بَيْنَ الْأذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «يَقْعُدُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Manṣūr b. Abī al-Aswad narrated to us, from Mughīra, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “The mu’adhdhin sits between the adhān and the iqāma.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا تَكُنُ أَوَّلَ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ (. . .) »
records.isnad_en: Ḥasan narrated to us, from Abū Ḥamza, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
records.matn_en: “Do not be the first of the mu’adhdhins (. . .)”
translator_notes: The saying breaks off with an ellipsis in the source.

groups.title_en: Chapter: Supplication Is Not Rejected Between the Adhān and the Iqāma
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: لَا يُرَدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِي مَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " لَا يُرَدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ
records.isnad_en: Sufyān narrated to us, from Zayd al-ʿAmmī, from Abū Iyās, from Anas, raising it (rafaʿahu), who said:
records.matn_en: “Supplication is not rejected between the adhān and the iqāma.”
translator_notes: ‘Raising it’ means that Anas attributes the saying to the Prophet ﷺ. The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يَرُدُّ الدُّعَاءُ فِي مَا بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ» .
records.isnad_en: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from Yazīd al-Raqāshī, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Supplication is not rejected between the adhān and the iqāma.”

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيَّ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْفَعُهُ مِثْلَهُ.
records.isnad_en: Abū ʿUmays narrated to us; he said: I heard Yazīd al-Raqāshī relate from Anas b. Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, raising it,
records.matn_en: the like of it.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

records.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُصَيْرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
records.isnad_en: Nuṣayr b. Abī al-Ashʿath narrated to us, from Yazīd al-Raqāshī, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ,
records.matn_en: the like of it.
records.no_isnad_reason: The Arabic of this report is shown undivided.

groups.title_en: Chapter: When It Is Cloudy, What Does One Do?
groups.title_ar: بَابٌ: إِذَا كَانَ الْغَيْمُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ حِزَامِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْغَيْمِ فَعَجِّلُوا الظُّهْرَ، وَأَخِّرُوا الْإِفْطَارَ»
records.isnad_en: Qays narrated to us, from Abū Ḥuṣayn, from Ḥizām b. Jābir, who said: ʿAbd Allāh said:
records.matn_en: “On a cloudy day, hasten al-Ẓuhr and delay the breaking of the fast.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «عَجِّلُوا صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ فِي يَوْمِ الْغَيْمِ»
records.isnad_en: Ḥasan narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Rufayʿ, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Hasten the ʿAṣr prayer on a cloudy day.”
translator_notes: Mursal: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Rufayʿ does not name a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مَاعِزٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ غَيْمٍ قَالَ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ: «اغْسِقِ اغْسِقْ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَعْنِي أَظْلِمْ أَظْلِمْ، يَعْنِي فِي الْمَغْرِبِ
records.isnad_en: Yūnus b. Abī Isḥāq narrated to us, from Bakr b. Māʿiz, who said:
